card.name: Words that lead into 'with' or comparison
card.fires_on: Words that set up a link or comparison with something else, such as 'connected', 'compared', 'connection' or 'equally', usually right before 'with', 'to' or 'as'. Seen mostly in general prose and in comparison statements.

modes.label: Compared / connected with
modes.description: 'compared' or 'connected' placed right before 'with' or 'to', introducing the second item.
modes.example: rates of animal performance and efficiency of feed utilization were almost doubled<< compared>> with the traditional method.

modes.label: Parallel remarks
modes.description: Short adverbs such as 'so', 'too' or 'equally' that add a parallel point about another item.
modes.example: Selden has missed it;<< so>> have Origen and Sophocles.

card.plain: It fires on words like 'compared' or 'connected' that are about to be followed by 'with' and the thing being compared.
